# Guided configuration conversational inputs

These are synthetic observations, not an installed Project, auth observation or
capability proof. Use the current four embedded skills as the subject's guidance.
Evaluate natural goal entry and the indicated explicit operation separately.
Explicit operations preserve their requested scope; inspect ends at inspection.
Repeat with operator host and target Runtime crossed. No real CLI effects are
permitted by these fixtures. A proposed event is not an observed operation.

Contract sources at baseline `6d5046440a2638630bfb729dfd8cff7184d74e23`:
`internal/cli/skill_inspect.go`, `internal/projectapp/policy_preview.go`,
`internal/projectapp/policy_apply.go`, `internal/projectapp/readiness.go`,
`internal/runtimeapplication/authoring.go`, `internal/cli/runtime_capability.go`.
Readiness Operations are work-item/execution; policy preview/readBack, local
runtimeAuthoring and workflowAuthoring have separate owner contracts. Snapshot
labels below stand for fixture identities, not valid wire digests. A test needing
real typed payloads must use the owning application test doubles instead of
submitting these labels to a command. No AXM-32 envelope is assumed.

Unless overridden: list/show resolved one UUID v4, source and explicit selector
alpha, Repository key api with matching declared remote and local binding;
portable schema 3 configured policy, local active-v3 eligible Profile, exact
selected schema-2 Workflow reference and relevant Stage/Agent requirements.
All required installed metadata, supported options and existing valid exact
observations are supplied synthetically. The scenario's readiness is scoped to
execution for that Workflow. Existing decisions stay valid until stated drift.
User goal: “Deixe o Project alpha pronto para executar Work Items”. For explicit
entry use the operation in the table with the same target and stated user intent.

For each independent variant record next operation/owner, question/decision,
source of alternatives, preflight/preview/consent/read-back ordering, proposed
writes/retries/dispatch and uncertainty. Compare with Spec 009 C01–C16 oracles.
Counts of proposed events must never be reported as actual writes or dispatches.
A tools-disabled conversation tests decisions on supplied observations only;
installed native parity, real C12 and AXM-12 E2E remain separate observations.
